8.24.2.5. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.area.AreaAtArea.getType¶

AreaAtArea.getType(typeName)¶

Return the GeoType object with the given typeName.

Parameters:typeName (string) – The name of the GeoPredicate object to be returned. Note that typeName must be a valid base type or compound type names defined in type_manager.
Return type:GeoType
Returns:Return the GeoType object with the given typeName.
